[[File:Guideboard-THX1138.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A guideboard at the Spaceport THX1138. It directs to ''The Nebula Trillion Parsec Club'' (left, the 3rd from top) in Aurebesh.]]
'''The Nebula Trillion Parsec Club''' was a pit stop and lounge for seasoned spacers across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], located at Level G in one of the wings of [[Spaceport THX1138]]. It included a Captain's Corner, [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] tables, [[Club Kessel]], various priority lift tubes, an Officer's Lounge, and various membership services.

*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}} {{1stm}}
